definitions.gloss: vegetable compartment; crisper drawer (in a refrigerator)
definitions.explanation: The dedicated compartment in a refrigerator for storing vegetables. Designed to maintain higher humidity and a slightly warmer temperature than the main compartment to keep produce fresh.

examples.japanese: {野菜室|やさいしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦レタス→レタス：05193_retasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put the lettuce in the vegetable compartment.

examples.japanese: {野菜室|やさいしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷蔵室|れいぞうしつ}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The vegetable compartment is warmer than the main refrigerator compartment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{野菜室|やさいしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}くて→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{使|つか}いやすい→使いやすい：30380_tsukaiyasui⟧。
examples.english: Large refrigerators have spacious vegetable compartments that are easy to use.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ (vegetables) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room, compartment). One of several specialized compartments in modern Japanese refrigerators.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野菜室|やさいしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in the vegetable compartment
- {野菜室|やさいしつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to take out of the vegetable compartment
- {野菜室|やさいしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: has a large vegetable compartment

- ⟦{冷凍室|れいとうしつ}→冷凍室：22293_reitoushitsu⟧: freezer compartment
- チルド⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧: chilled compartment (just above freezing)
